instructionsMarkdown:
# Visual Studio Code Power Configuration & Workspace Tooling

Standardize VS Code workspaces for automated team consistency, reproducible debugging, and containerized development.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Commit workspace `.vscode/launch.json` and `.vscode/tasks.json` to version control.
- List all required workspace plugins inside `.vscode/extensions.json`.
- Enforce `editor.formatOnSave` and `editor.codeActionsOnSave` adhering to project linting standards.
- Provide a reproducible `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` for hermetic onboarding.
